quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. Speed advisory plaques tell you the safe speed to drive through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to watch for a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell you about traffic laws. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check all directions for traffic before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check all directions for traffic before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop. Look all around for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No trucks allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill. Slow down and control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you cannot enter. You may see it on one-way streets or if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot turn right where this sign is posted. It is unsafe and illegal to turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The light will change to red soon.
The light will change to green soon.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light will change to red soon.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns you that the signal is about to turn red. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that road work is coming up. Pay attention to temporary traffic control signs in work zones.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that a traffic signal is ahead at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you. Stop if necessary before moving forward.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, check for crossing traffic and pedestrians, and then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic from the right may merge into your lane. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you pedestrians may be crossing. If someone is crossing in a marked crosswalk, stop and wait until they are completely across.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may merge ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way highway. You will soon be driving on a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limits.

questions.question: This sign shows a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing marked with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It warns you to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards or road conditions. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn you about road conditions. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Slow down appropriately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn about road conditions ahead, including curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether or not there is a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that a school zone or school crossing is ahead. When you see this sign, stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road splits. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means there is a side road intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch carefully and stop if children are using the crosswalk.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much vertical space is available under a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon merge into one lane.

questions.question: When you approach an octagonal sign, what must you do?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. Orange signs are used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What message will you find on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or gets narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or gets narrower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is about to change direction or become narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, and then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You will often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on the back of vehicles moving slower than 25 mph, such as farm equipment, construction machinery, or horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. These spaces are for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs always warn you about a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a reverse curve where the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions you may not see right away. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and adjust your brakes to avoid accidents and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs give information about motorist services. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals nearby.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Only proceed when it is safe. Stop before the crosswalk if there is no stop line, or before the intersection if there is no crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black symbols warn drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic will merge ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black symbols warn drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: This sign warns of:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs warn drivers about conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs warn drivers about conditions immediately ahead. This sign tells you to slow down because the road will turn sharply.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs warn drivers about conditions immediately ahead. This sign tells you to be ready for traffic merging from the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are coming to:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells drivers to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming up. Start to slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that there will be fewer lanes ahead. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to possible dangers and are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign tell a driver?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright vests or jackets. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic through work zones and let workers cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to watch for bicycles and other traffic that may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: This sign is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle sign means yield. Slow down and stop if needed. If you must stop, do so at a marked stop line.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black letters or symbols and tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: An orange sign like this means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you of two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic laws they must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers about traffic laws in that area. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
You must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that allows you to turn in the direction you want.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. You can lose control of your vehicle. Slow down when you see wet roads because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangle on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, maintenance vehicles, and horse-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left turns allowed only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign means left turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is beginning. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean work zone ahead. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is coming. You must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells you the traffic rule you must follow. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead. Be ready for other traffic or to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see it on farm equipment, work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks solid orange during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards just ahead. This sign warns you about an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway. You are about to enter a road where traffic goes both ways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has curves.
